rca.principle: Exit 137 is SIGKILL, not necessarily an OOM kill. Count memory pressure only when Kubernetes last_reason is OOMKilled. The rest is PROBE-KILL.

findings.title: OOMKilled then CrashLoopBackOff
findings.evidence: 7 restarts, last exit 137, last_reason=OOMKilled, liveness HTTP 000, memory at the 1536 MiB limit.
findings.likely_cause: MAE consumer applying MetadataAuditEvent traffic while Elasticsearch bulk indexing lagged; heap plus off-heap buffers hit the pod limit.
findings.suggested: Raise the mae-consumer memory limit toward 2Gi, inspect Kafka lag on MetadataAuditEvent_v4, confirm Elasticsearch is accepting bulk index requests.

findings.title: MAE Kafka listener concurrency is 1
findings.evidence: platform.mae_kafka_listener_concurrency=1 with MAE already OOM looping.
findings.likely_cause: Single-threaded apply cannot drain MetadataAuditEvent_v4, so UI search goes stale while GMS counts still look fine.
findings.suggested: Raise MAE listener concurrency with partition count; only after memory headroom exists.

findings.title: Executor memory high between UI ingestions
findings.evidence: 1802 / 2048 MiB in the 5m fixture window; 1 restart on the executor pod.
findings.likely_cause: acryl-datahub-actions runs UI ingestion recipes in-process (the executor action).
findings.suggested: Stagger postgres and oracle recipes; avoid overlapping hourly postgres-analytics with an on-demand run.

findings.title: Prior Error restart, now Running
findings.likely_cause: Transient MCE apply failure (proposal rejected or GMS timeout) that recovered.
findings.suggested: Watch mce-consumer logs on the next ingestion; no config change from this fixture alone.

changes.why: MAE already sits at the pod limit. Search/index apply is the first wall.
GraphQL + ingestProposal + search fan-out at 1M entities.
MCP apply volume follows ingestion, not UI traffic.
Executor already at 88% memory between two small sources.
Dataset + timeseries + search indices dominate storage.
One partition cannot drain 1M-asset audit traffic.
GMS aspect rows and usage stats grow with unique urns.
10× the 1M MAE plan; keep consumer lag near zero or search goes stale.
Search and GraphQL become the hot path; one replica will timeout.
Bulk ingest windows otherwise back up MetadataChangeEvent_v4.

recipes.postgres:
pipeline_name: postgres-lab-demo
source:
  type: postgres
  config:
    host_port: db.lab.example:5432
    database: analytics
    username: datahub_reader
    password: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    include_tables: true
    include_views: true
    schema_pattern:
      allow:
        - public
        - reporting
    table_pattern:
      allow:
        - public.orders
        - public.customers
        - public.inventory
        - reporting.daily_kpis
sink:
  type: datahub-rest
  config:
    server: http://datahub-gms:8080
recipes.oracle:
pipeline_name: oracle-finance-daily
source:
  type: oracle
  config:
    host_port: oracle.lab.example:1521
    username: datahub_reader
    password: ${ORACLE_PASSWORD}
    service_name: FINLAB
    include_tables: true
    include_views: true
    schema_pattern:
      allow:
        - FINAPP
        - REFDATA
sink:
  type: datahub-rest
  config:
    server: http://datahub-gms:8080

endpoints.title: Frontend / GMS login
endpoints.summary: Create a session. This lab accepts JSON {username, password}. Fictional user emuser / empass. Not a live tenant.

endpoints.title: List incidents (alerts)

endpoints.title: List ingestion sources
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query listIngestionSources(input: ListIngestionSourcesInput!). Returns urn, name, type, schedule, nested executions.

endpoints.title: Create an ingestion source
endpoints.summary: GraphQL mutation createIngestionSource(input: UpdateIngestionSourceInput!). type must match the recipe (postgres, oracle). config.recipe is a JSON-encoded recipe. config.executorId is the datahub-actions executor.

endpoints.title: Update an ingestion source
endpoints.summary: GraphQL mutation updateIngestionSource(urn, input: UpdateIngestionSourceInput!).

endpoints.title: Create an ingestion execution request
endpoints.summary: GraphQL mutation createIngestionExecutionRequest. Required input: ingestionSourceUrn. Returns the run / execution-request urn. datahub-actions executes it.

endpoints.title: List execution requests
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query listExecutionRequests. Poll result.status PENDING | RUNNING | SUCCESS | FAILURE.

endpoints.title: Get one ingestion source
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query ingestionSource(urn: String!).

endpoints.title: Search across entities
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query searchAcrossEntities. Use types DATASET, CONTAINER, DATA_JOB for asset counts in this lab. Not used for INGESTION_SOURCE run history.

endpoints.title: Get a dataset by urn
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query dataset(urn). Aspects such as schemaMetadata, upstreamLineage, datasetProperties.

endpoints.title: GMS health
endpoints.summary: datahub-gms process health. Mock returns ok=true.

endpoints.title: GMS config
endpoints.summary: Public GMS config payload (stateful ingestion flags, etc.). Mock returns a stub.

endpoints.title: Ingest a metadata change proposal
endpoints.summary: REST MCP apply. Alternative to GraphQL entity emit. Used by some CLI sinks.

endpoints.title: Legacy entity search
endpoints.summary: Older GMS search action. Prefer GraphQL searchAcrossEntities in new tests.

endpoints.title: Postgres recipe coordinates
endpoints.summary: host_port, username, database, schema_pattern.allow, table_pattern.allow. Sink datahub-rest to datahub-gms.

endpoints.title: Oracle recipe coordinates
endpoints.summary: host_port, username, service_name or database (not both), schema_pattern.allow.

endpoints.title: datahub-gms
endpoints.summary: Generalized Metadata Service. Serves GraphQL and REST. CPU/memory in this lab come from the metrics fixture.
